product_owner_answers.primary_user: A lab member checking many computational runs between other tasks; failures must be visible in seconds.
product_owner_answers.priority: Order status groups Failed, Attention, Running, Queued, Complete; within a group show newest first.
product_owner_answers.search: Case-insensitive search matches run name, owner, method or model, and run id.
product_owner_answers.filters: Support All plus each status. Search and status filter combine, and an empty result explains how to clear filters.
product_owner_answers.failure_action: A failed item exposes its failure reason and a visible Retry affordance. The demo can update local state; no backend is needed.
product_owner_answers.responsive: At 390px there is no horizontal page scroll. Dense table rows may become cards but retain status, owner, timing, and failure information.
product_owner_answers.accessibility: Keyboard users can reach search, status filters, and row actions. Use visible focus and programmatic labels; color is not the only status signal.

acceptance.criterion: Initial view contains at least eight realistic runs across Failed, Attention, Running, Queued, and Complete, with Failed and Attention above lower-priority groups.
Search is case-insensitive across name, owner, method/model, and id; status filter combines with search and can be cleared.
Summary counts reflect the complete seeded set and an empty filtered state is actionable.
Failed runs expose reason and a working local Retry action that changes visible status without corrupting totals.
At 1440x900 and 390x844 all load-bearing information remains readable with no horizontal page scroll.
Search, filters, and actions are keyboard operable with visible focus and accessible names; statuses are not color-only.
Automated tests cover priority ordering, combined filtering, empty state, and retry state change; production build succeeds.

robustness: Unknown or missing optional metadata renders a safe fallback rather than crashing.
Search text with spaces or mixed case behaves predictably.
Rapid filter changes do not leave stale counts or selection.
visual_review: Failure hierarchy is apparent before reading every label.
Typography, spacing, and density fit a serious research tool rather than a generic demo.
